items.description: Return the talkgroup-alias map (TG number → display name).
Replace the alias map. Body is a JSON object keyed by TG number.
Stream live vocoder PCM as an open-ended WAV (8 kHz 16-bit mono).
One-shot ring dump of the vocoder's internal test tone buffer; diagnostic.
List known P25 identifier_update frequency bands (base, spacing, offset, BW).
Read the runtime BCH(63,16,t) error-correction cap for each decoder.
Override the BCH-t cap at runtime without rebuilding. Reset with t=reset.
3-column matrix: PS C4FM vs PS LSM framer vs PL HDL LSM runtime stats.
Reset the framer state of one of the decoders (keeps cumulative counters).
Same as GET /api/decoder_reset; HTTP-method-correct variant.
Sample the C4FM dibit ring and return histogram + raw DUID hits for inspection.
Read the sticky encrypted-TG history set (TGs ever seen encrypted).
Overwrite the encrypted-TG blocklist. Useful for manual curation.
This catalogue. Self-describing list of every /api/* route.
Active voice-channel grants (one entry per TG currently on a traffic channel).
PL HDL LSM chain runtime snapshot: NID events, NAC histogram, PLL/sync debug taps.
Dump recent IMBE frame batches for offline vocoder cross-check.
Per-source IRQ counters (dibit / iq / lsm_dibit / traffic DMAs).
Event log ring. Monotonic seq for incremental tail reads.
Rolling snapshot of the control LSM decoder's recent dibits (post-demod, up to 2048).
Sync-aligned one-shot dibit + decoded-frame trace for offline pipeline cross-check.
Post-DDC complex IQ from the control chain as a WAV file (stereo i16 @ 62.5 kSPS, I=L / Q=R). SDRTrunk-ingestible.
Runtime read/write of the control-chain lsm_control register bits.
Histogram of the control-chain LSM demod dibit ring (not C4FM).
Traffic-chain twin of /api/control_dibit_capture. Rolling dibit snapshot.
Traffic-chain twin of /api/control_dibit_capture_aligned. Arms next sync hit.
Traffic-chain twin of /api/control_iq_dump. Post-DDC IQ WAV, centered on the follower's current NCO offset.
Runtime read/write of the traffic-chain lsm_control register bits.
Histogram of the traffic-chain LSM demod dibit ring.
Read or set AD9361 RX hardwaregain (range -3..76) and AGC mode. mode applied before db if both present.
PUT twin for /api/rx_gain — same semantics as the GET form.
Accumulated grant-frequency map (tg, freq) with counts + last-seen.
Read current P25 modulation (C4FM/LSM/Auto) + per-decoder NID-valid rates.
Override or release modulation selection. Auto picks whichever decoder has more valid NIDs.
Read the TG monitor list (when non-empty, only listed TGs get followed).
Add/remove a TG from the monitor list. Empty list = newest-grant-wins.
Batched NID capture for t-sweep analysis by tools/p25_nid_analyze.py.
Last ~50 decoded TSBKs with summaries for the activity feed.
Ring of recent call recordings: id, TG, started_unix_ms, duration_ms, size_bytes.
Download a recording as WAV (8 kHz 16-bit mono).
Live front-end + DDC re-init without reboot. Unspecified fields use boot defaults.
Post-PLL soft-symbol (I, Q) scatter via the software LSM demod pipeline.
Force the wall clock from a browser-pushed value. Fallback for boards without NTP reachability.
FFT over post-DDC IQ ring, mag_db array fftshifted. Averages N non-overlapping segments for noise-floor suppression.
Decoder stats + AD9361 readback (gain/RSSI/rx_lo/rf_bandwidth/ddc offset/uptime).
Read the per-decoder runtime sync threshold.
Override the sync-detector Hamming-distance threshold at runtime.
Process + kernel health: loadavg, RSS, thread count, free memory. Cheap to poll.
System identity: WACN/NAC/RFSS/site, build tag, control channel.
Traffic-follower state + manual debug knobs (retune_hz routes through full chain).
Histogram of TSBK opcodes observed. Labels match SDRTrunk OSP opcode names.
WebSocket binary stream of AudioChunk payloads (used by dashboard player).
WebSocket text stream of decoder + traffic events as JSON lines.

WebSocket binary stream of IQ sub-buffers (32 KB each, i16 LE interleaved). source=post_ddc (default, 62.5 kSPS unfiltered) or post_lsm (31.25 kSPS, matched-filter output — the eye-plot source). Hello text frame on connect.
